| `--water` | Dollars per 1000 gal. | 4.10 |

| `--labour` | Dollars per hour. | 74.00 |
| `--permit` | Dollars per permit job. | 120.00 |

| `--efficiency` | Boiler efficiency, as a fraction. | 0.82 |
| `--condensate-returned` | Share of the condensate that comes back. | 0.75 |
